summary: Iteration 12 - Phase 2b cleanup validation (Customers/Leads/Payments/Products migration to shared `api` instance with cookie auth). Code-level verification: NO `localStorage.getItem('token')` reads remain in pages/* or utils/*; NO Bearer headers constructed in Customers.js, Leads.js, Payments.js; Products.js correctly DELETED (only ProductsEnhanced.js exists, App.js routes /products to it); api.js interceptor removed legacy token logic - cookie-only auth source. Live Playwright verification with full network + console capture: 196 /api/* calls observed across login + 6 protected pages + CRUD operations - ZERO calls carried an Authorization header (Bearer null fully eliminated). ZERO uncaught ReferenceError in console. Customers CRUD: POST /customers=200, PUT /customers/{id}=200 as data_entry. Payments page opens '+ Record Payment' modal cleanly (handleSubmit/fetchPayments scope fix verified - no ReferenceError). Products page loads, contains Product UI. Hard reload preserves session. Logout clears cookie and direct /dashboard redirects to /login. Employee (rajesh) lands on /daily-tasks and is gated from /customers. All Phase 1 & Phase 2 regressions intact.

issues: Two duplicate '+ Add Lead' buttons rendered (mobile lg:hidden block + desktop hidden lg:block block). Functionally fine but creates DOM duplication and breaks naive Playwright `:has-text` selectors picking the wrong (hidden) one. Consider consolidating with a single button + responsive className OR adding distinct data-testid on each (e.g. add-lead-btn-mobile / add-lead-btn-desktop).

action_items: Optional: Add data-testid attributes to '+ Add Lead' (mobile/desktop), '+ Record Payment', and Lead Update buttons to make Playwright selectors deterministic across viewport breakpoints.
Optional: Leads.js still reads localStorage.getItem('user') line 26 (UI role gating) - this is not auth and is fine, but for consistency could be replaced with useAuth() hook like Customers.js does.
critical_code_review_comments: api.js (post-cleanup) is clean - cookie-only auth, no token interceptor, response interceptor correctly skips redirect on /auth/me bootstrap probe and on public pages.

Payments.js: fetchPayments and fetchInvoices correctly hoisted to component scope with useCallback, useEffect deps include them - the prior ReferenceError on save (where handleSubmit referenced fetchPayments defined inside useEffect) is fully fixed.

Customers.js: cleanly migrated to `api.X(path)` calls; uses useAuth() hook (good); minor - the Edit modal does not pre-fill new fields vat_reg_no / cr_no / division (line 66-74). Existing values for those fields will appear blank in edit modal and silently overwrite to '' on save. This is a pre-existing data-loss bug NOT introduced by Phase 2b but should be addressed.
Leads.js: still reads `user` from localStorage instead of useAuth() - inconsistency with Customers.js, not a bug but code-quality.
Two '+ Add Lead' buttons in Leads.js (mobile + desktop blocks) is duplicated JSX - extract into a component or use a single button with `lg:px-4 lg:py-2 px-3 py-1.5` responsive classes.
